description: Six to Ten of Cups in tarot: upright and reversed meanings, from nostalgia and choice to contentment and belonging, with notes for your tarot spread.
lede: The Six to Ten of Cups move from memory and daydreams to contentment and belonging. Each card has an upright and a reversed meaning.

faces.alt: Five original gold-linework tarot card faces in a row, in order: Six of Cups, Seven of Cups, Eight of Cups, Nine of Cups and Ten of Cups. Each shows its number and a cup icon with the card name beneath. No scenes are drawn.
faces.caption: Six to Ten of Cups in order, shown as simple number-and-suit card faces.
